rules.description: Non-DHCP IP traffic is present; verify that it follows the ACK and crosses the NAT boundary in the analysis.

manual_checks: Correlate the DHCP lease with the client address and timestamps. Compare internal/external capture points for address translation and return traffic.
R1 R2 R3 R4: Correlate transaction/client identity and the Discover–Offer–Request–ACK order.
R5: Compare internal and external source addresses, routes, NAT/FORWARD rules and the complete reply path.
